name: ARPANET created
description: ARPANET, the precursor to the internet, is created by the Advanced Research Projects Agency.

name: First email sent
description: Ray Tomlinson sends the first email using the @ symbol to separate the user from the host in the email address.

name: TCP/IP protocol introduced
description: Vinton Cerf and Robert Kahn publish a paper introducing the Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) and Internet Protocol (IP), laying the foundations for the modern internet.

name: Domain Name System (DNS) created
description: The Domain Name System is implemented, allowing the use of domain names instead of IP addresses for website addresses.

name: World Wide Web invented
description: Tim Berners-Lee develops the World Wide Web, a system that allows the retrieval and navigation of information linked by hypertext.

name: First web browser released
description: Tim Berners-Lee releases the first web browser, called WorldWideWeb.

name: First website goes live
description: The world's first website, info.cern.ch, goes live.

name: Mosaic web browser released
description: The Mosaic web browser is released, popularizing the graphical user interface (GUI) for the web.

name: Netscape Navigator released
description: Netscape Navigator, one of the most popular web browsers of its time, is released.

name: Yahoo! founded
description: Jerry Yang and David Filo create Yahoo!, one of the first widely-used search engines and web portals.

name: Amazon.com launched
description: Jeff Bezos launches Amazon.com, an online marketplace for books.

name: eBay founded
description: Pierre Omidyar establishes eBay, an online auction and shopping website.

name: Google founded
description: Larry Page and Sergey Brin found Google, a search engine that revolutionizes internet search.

name: Napster launched
description: Napster, a peer-to-peer file sharing service, is launched by Shawn Fanning and Sean Parker.

name: Wikipedia launched
description: The collaborative online encyclopedia, Wikipedia, is launched by Jimmy Wales and Larry Sanger.

name: Facebook launched
description: Mark Zuckerberg creates Facebook, a social networking site that becomes immensely popular worldwide.

name: YouTube launched
description: Chad Hurley, Steve Chen, and Jawed Karim launch YouTube, a video-sharing platform that revolutionizes online video consumption.

name: Twitter launched
description: Jack Dorsey, Biz Stone, and Evan Williams create Twitter, a microblogging platform that allows users to share short messages.

name: iPhone released
description: Apple releases the first iPhone, revolutionizing the mobile internet and ushering in the smartphone era.

name: Android operating system released
description: Google releases the Android operating system, providing an open-source platform for smartphones.

name: Instagram launched
description: Kevin Systrom and Mike Krieger launch Instagram, a photo and video sharing social networking service.

name: WhatsApp launched
description: Jan Koum and Brian Acton launch WhatsApp, a popular messaging app.

name: Snapchat launched
description: Evan Spiegel, Bobby Murphy, and Reggie Brown launch Snapchat, an image and multimedia messaging app.

name: TikTok launched
description: Zhang Yiming launches TikTok, a social networking app for creating and sharing short videos.

name: Bitcoin created
description: Satoshi Nakamoto introduces Bitcoin, the first decentralized cryptocurrency.

name: Netflix expands to streaming
description: Netflix transitions from a DVD rental service to a streaming platform, changing the way people consume movies and TV shows.

name: Cloud computing gains popularity
description: Cloud computing becomes increasingly popular, allowing users to access and store data remotely.

name: Artificial Intelligence advancements
description: Advancements in Artificial Intelligence lead to breakthroughs in areas such as natural language processing and computer vision.
